description: List the blog posts nearpedia holds: articles, news and press releases from NEAR, and in tabs of their own partner press and third-party reprints. Omit source for what the Blog page shows under All. Pass query to search titles and text. Returns metadata only (id, title, kind, author, date); call get_blog_post with an id to read one. Release notes are not blog posts: they are under /releases.

limit.description: How many posts to return. Default 20, max 50.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

query.description: Words to look for in titles and text. Results come best match first.

source.description: Which tab: blog (Blog), news (News), press-release (Press), partner-news (Partner press), third-party (Third-party). Omit for All, which is first-party writing only.

name: list_blog_posts
